profile.name: GlaxoSmithKline Pharmaceuticals Ltd (GSK India)
profile.fiscalYear: April-March since the 15-month period January 2014 to March 2015 (previously January-December); FY26 = year to 31-Mar-2026. Confirmed in AR FY26 (statements 'for the year ended 31st March 2026') and the AR FY22 ten-year summary note 5
profile.parent: GSK plc, UK (ultimate holding company) through Glaxo Group Ltd UK 35.99%, GlaxoSmithKline Pte Ltd Singapore 28.10%, Eskaylab Ltd UK 6.94% and Burroughs Wellcome International Ltd UK 3.97% = 75.00% (AR FY26 note 17 and shareholder information)
profile.business: Prescription medicines and vaccines sold in India (98.6% of FY26 revenue; exports ₹52 cr). Three businesses: general medicines (more than 80% of revenue: Augmentin, Calpol, Ceftum, T-Bact, Betnovate, Eltroxin, Neosporin, Tenovate, CCM, Cobadex CZS, Physiogel), vaccines (paediatric: Infanrix Hexa, Boostrix, Havrix, Varilrix, Synflorix, Priorix, Menveo, Fluarix Tetra; adult: Shingrix) and specialty (respiratory: Nucala, Trelegy Ellipta, Seretide; oncology since Sep-2025: Jemperli, Zejula; Blenrep approved 2026). One owned plant (Ambad, Nashik: 334 mn packs a year) plus ~20 contract manufacturers for general medicines; vaccines and specialty products are imported from GSK group companies
profile.employees: 3,103 permanent employees (Mar-26); ~2,000 general-medicine representatives, ~200 in established vaccines and ~45 in oncology (Q1FY27 call)
profile.subsidiary: Biddle Sawyer Ltd (100%): contract manufacturing for the parent and some third-party sales (total revenue ₹51.5 cr, assets ₹75.6 cr in FY26); paid a one-off dividend to the parent in Q1FY27

fy26._note: Consolidated statement of profit and loss, cash flows and notes 26-36. EBITDA = revenue less materials, purchases, inventory change, employee and other expenses (company: EBITDA ₹1,300 cr / 34% standalone). FY25: revenue 3,749.21, EBITDA 1,177.36 (31.4%), other income 145.93, PAT 927.58, EPS 54.76 (54.52 before exceptional items), CFO 1,289.90

q1fy27.guidance: EBITDA margin 'roughly what we were at last year in 34% kind of range' for FY27; selling and admin ratios to normalise after a front-loaded Q1; base business to grow 8-10% a year and the whole company 13-14% over the medium term with launches; '₹8,000 crores of top line in four to five years' (analyst question; MD: 'the 2x vision still remains intact'); no formal guidance ('I don't generally give forward-looking guidance')
q1fy27.launches: Blenrep (belantamab mafodotin, second-line relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma) approved by CDSCO, launch 'in the next two months, two to three months latest' (Q2 or Q3FY27); Arexvy (RSV vaccine for older adults) received marketing authorisation; bepirovirsen (chronic hepatitis B) 'three to four quarters away at least'; Ojjaara in 18-24 months
q1fy27.src: Q1FY27 deck (3-Aug-2026): https://www.bseindia.com/stockinfo/AnnPdfOpen.aspx?Pname=ea29c43f-5e77-4ed8-b9de-d5ff92ce73b9.pdf; call transcript (filed 6-Aug-2026); Screener.in quarterly results; Motilal Oswal results update (3-Aug-2026) for consolidated detail

q4fy26.fy26GenMedGrowth: more or less flat (more than ₹100 cr lost to the CMO supply constraint; 3-4% underlying)

q3fy26.cmo: Fire at a contract manufacturer making Calpol, Cobadex CZS and other products (April 2025); supply hit for almost three quarters; ₹25-30 cr lost in Q3FY26 alone
q3fy26.doubling: 'This organization has to grow in the range of 12% to 13% annually over the next five years so that we can double the business from where we were in '23-'24 to the point of becoming an INR8,000 crores business'
q3fy26.genMedShare: more than 75%-78% of our topline revenue
q3fy26.nlem: 'almost one-third... Over 35% of our overall portfolio is under price control, 35%-38%'
q3fy26.freshness: Innovation 10-15% of sales targeted for FY27 (oncology, Shingrix, RSV vaccine, Blenrep); ~20-25% over five to seven years

portfolio.innovationDefinition: Oncology (Jemperli + Zejula) + new respiratory (Nucala + Trelegy) + adult vaccines (Shingrix)
portfolio.brandsTop100: 7 brands in the IPM top 100: Augmentin, Calpol, Betnovate-C, Betnovate-N, Ceftum, Eltroxin, T-Bact; 15 brands above ₹100 cr a year (IQVIA MAT Mar-2026)
portfolio.ranks: #1 in private vaccines and dermatology; #2 among MNCs; #5 in acute therapies by volume (AR FY26)
portfolio.augmentin: #3 brand in the IPM; most prescribed antibiotic
portfolio.calpol: Nearly one-third of the paracetamol market; most prescribed brand in India
portfolio.ceftum: Volumes doubled despite price cuts mandated in 2023
portfolio.shingrix: Crossed ₹100 cr on a moving-annual basis (Q1FY27); ~1,400 prescribers (FY26); repositioned to cardio-metabolic patients
portfolio.trelegy: Generics of umeclidinium launched from Apr-2025 (10-12 generics); GSK holds ~10,000-12,000 units a month
portfolio.oncology: Jemperli (dostarlimab, first-line endometrial cancer) and Zejula (niraparib, ovarian maintenance) launched Sep-2025; ~25 then ~45 oncology representatives; treatment cost ₹10-16 lakh a patient with patient-assistance programmes
portfolio.pipeline: 26 ongoing and planned clinical trials in India (AR FY26); Blenrep approved; Arexvy authorised; bepirovirsen (hepatitis B), efruxifermin (MASH), B7-H4 ADC and velzatinib in trials
